iulr.title: Interstellar Union of Liberated Republics
supportedFacts: New Avendon is the capital; its astronomical type and host system are not specified
The Union was founded in the ruins of Avedon; its present sovereignty, astronomical type, and host system are not specified

tora.title: Terranos Omnidirectional Reflector Array
supportedFacts: A network of space stations operated by the IULR
Cloaks controlled systems and their planets; distant telescope detection suppressed beyond one light year
Within one light year telescope detection becomes possible, while most ship-grade sensors remain ineffective
Highly energetic objects such as pulsars and black holes are exceptions to the general concealment
Long-distance internal communication depends on specialized quantum networks

parts.title: Reflector panels
parts.label: PANELS
parts.note: Three pairs of broad, segmented panels extend from the central structure. The array network screens Union systems from distant observation.

parts.title: Equatorial hub
parts.label: HUB
parts.note: The panel trusses meet at the cyan-banded hub. The class carries approximately 2,500 crew. The deck plan is undisclosed.

parts.title: Ventral spindle
parts.label: SPINDLE
parts.note: A stepped lower hull tapers to a second axial tip. The class power plant is classified and its position is unknown.

presentation.notesHTML:
IULR Stellar Atlas · 134 CE · Edition 9

Reading the chart

Drag or pinch to navigate. Choose a chart with the dropdown. Click open territory, or focus its boundary and press Enter, to highlight a region without moving the camera. Overview labels appear at 150% and planet sublabels at 220%; a highlighted region uses 120% and 150%. Regional charts use 70% and 90% for the highlighted region, 90% and 135% for neighbors. If the map’s shorter dimension is below 520 pixels, thresholds increase proportionally to preserve legibility. Hover over the zoom percentage for the current thresholds. The Labels control also hides region inscriptions. Select a symbol for its dossier, or double-click a system or planet to enter its chart. Names link to the Codex. Collapse either side panel for more chart space. Escape steps back, arrow keys pan the focused map, +/− zoom and 0 fits the region.

Source and scope

The Codex identifies the Union’s 41 systems, approximately 228 billion people, its capital New Avendon, and its location in the Iryddis Region. Atlas divisions, system positions and planetary orbits follow the proposed IULR master register v3. Station counts follow this atlas edition. Avedon is the ruined founding site tentatively placed on Vaaskel, and Ysh Zaħah is the Turahk homeworld tentatively placed in the Zhaur system.

Orbital diagrams

All 265 primary planetary slots are catalogued. The 168 without proper names use a dimmer symbol. Moons use provisional catalogue designations. Planetary charts show their full satellite families. Close pairs host circumbinary planets. Trinaries add a distant companion C, shown separately. Spacing, sizes and speeds are schematic.

TORA shroud

Each system has one or two proposed arrays, included in its station total. Flowing blue waves at the edges mark engineered cloaking. Nearby telescopes and exceptional energetic objects limit concealment. The arrays are shown in the lower-left register beyond the scale of the planetary orbits. This edition charts 249 ordinary stations plus 59 distant arrays. Each system diagram shows one or two major facilities. Planetary diagrams show each host’s full station inventory.

Live planet article titles

Planets retain their atlas names until a matching Codex article exists. When an article exists, its canonical MediaWiki page title is displayed on labels, orbital diagrams, dossiers and links. Page moves normally leave redirects that this atlas follows; page IDs are additionally remembered per browser for moves without redirects. Return to this tab or select Refresh data to check for changes. If the wiki is offline, saved titles or atlas fallback names remain visible. For a move without a redirect before any visit, keep a redirect from the original article title or update the planet’s articleTitle in the register so new visitors can locate it.

Embeds and live records

Use ?region=avendonraik&view=widget, ?system=edraanvek&view=widget or ?planet=New%20Avendon&view=widget. For a compact interactive atlas use ?embed=1. EmbedMap accepts the same parameters through window.SKYRIVER_ATLAS_QUERY. Dossier refresh checks the selected article, supports current and legacy infoboxes, and retains available records offline.
